summary: Inspect one query's ranked passages, its fixed top-k retriever prior, and separately defined latent-document contributions in a bounded RAG formulation without presenting retrieval as citation proof.
objective: Select a retrieved passage or generated token and trace its stored score, query-conditioned retriever prior, text identity, and distinct role in the declared RAG-Sequence or RAG-Token calculation.
intent_signals: Show which passages a RAG query retrieved and how they were weighted.
Inspect retrieval rank, the fixed retriever prior, and separately computed token-wise document contributions without claiming citation faithfulness.
example_prompts: Build a RAG retrieval inspector for one query, its top-k passages, and a generated answer, separating the fixed retriever prior from token-wise document contributions.
not_for: Certifying that a generated claim is entailed by a passage.
Inferring original-space retrieval rank from projected 3D distance.
Comparing arbitrary retrievers as though their scores shared one scale.

entities.name: Query and ranked passages
entities.guidance: Keep stable passage IDs, source titles, text locators, stored high-dimensional scores, and rank visible. If vectors are projected for layout, label the projection as display-only and never derive retrieval order from it.

entities.name: Retriever distribution
entities.guidance: Show top-k logits and the query-conditioned retriever prior p_eta(z|x) as a table or stacked bar. State whether it is normalized over the displayed truncation. This prior stays fixed across generated-token positions for one query and retrieval result.

entities.name: Generation provenance strip
entities.guidance: For RAG-Token, an optional token-conditioned contribution c_i(z) may place generation step on one axis, passage identity on another, and contribution on the vertical axis. Define c_i(z)=p_eta(z|x)p_theta(y_i|x,z,y_<i)/sum_z' p_eta(z'|x)p_theta(y_i|x,z',y_<i), normalize over the same identified top-k set, and label it separately from the retriever prior. Link selection to the exact passage and token; do not turn a high contribution into a claim of textual entailment.

state_contract.model: One supplied query x, a fixed identified passage index, integer k, retrieved passage records z_j, retriever logits s_j=d(z_j)^T q(x), query-conditioned top-k retriever prior p_eta(z_j|x)=softmax_j(s), and a declared RAG-Sequence or RAG-Token calculation. Store original vectors and scores separately from any 3D projection. The retriever prior remains fixed across token positions for this query/result. If token-conditioned contributions are supplied or computed for RAG-Token, identify the generator and prefix and define c_i(z_j)=p_eta(z_j|x)p_theta(y_i|x,z_j,y_<i)/sum_l p_eta(z_l|x)p_theta(y_i|x,z_l,y_<i) over the same top-k set; c_i is a normalized contribution to the token marginal, not a changing retriever prior.
state_contract.authority: The supplied query, index revision, passage identities, logits, fixed retriever prior, generation tokens, generator likelihoods, separately identified token contributions, and model variant own all semantic readouts. A camera move, PCA layout, highlight, or hidden passage changes no score or probability.
actions: Select a passage and inspect source identity, text, score, rank, and fixed retriever-prior weight.

Select a generated token and inspect its separately labeled c_i passage contributions only when the generator likelihoods or recorded contributions needed to reproduce them are supplied; keep p_eta(z|x) visibly fixed.
Change k only by rerunning retrieval or loading a recorded result for that k, then recompute every displayed distribution for that identified top-k set.
Toggle original-vector and projected-layout readouts without substituting projected distance for the retrieval score.
Reset query, k, selection, token step, filters, and camera.

invariants: Displayed rank is the stable ordering of the stored retriever scores under the declared tie policy.
The displayed top-k retriever prior is nonnegative, sums to 1 within tolerance, and is identical across token positions for a fixed query and retrieval result.

Every displayed token-conditioned c_i contribution is nonnegative, sums to 1 over the identified top-k set within tolerance, and reproduces the declared retriever-prior-times-generator-likelihood formula.
Every passage and token bar links to a stable source or model-output identity; missing provenance remains missing rather than receiving an invented citation.
Projected 3D coordinates never overwrite the original vector, logit, rank, passage identity, or model step.
motion_guidance: Animate query-to-passage highlighting as inspection order, not network latency or physical travel.
Scrubbing generation changes the selected token step from recorded or computed state; interpolation between steps is presentation only.
creative_affordances: Use an evidence library, index chamber, or restrained technical graph, provided text identity and numerical panels remain primary.
Passage ranks may form shelves, lanes, or small multiples; layout distance carries no retrieval meaning unless separately defined.
known_limits: The original RAG paper supplies a particular research architecture and experimental index; this recipe is not a universal contract for current RAG systems.
Retrieved passages and latent-document weights expose model state but do not prove that generated claims are supported, entailed, or faithfully cited.
Approximate retrieval, index freshness, chunk construction, reranking, and generator behavior require their own recorded contracts.
Authored recipe and prospective checks only; no retriever, generator, scene, or rendered result was run or observed.

claims.statement: The original RAG formulation retrieves a top-k truncated distribution over passages and marginalizes latent documents either once for an output sequence or within each generated-token probability; its retriever scores passages using dense query-document inner products.
claims.scope: Lewis et al.'s RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token formulations and DPR-based retriever, not later products called RAG and not citation faithfulness.

source_refs.locator: Sections 2.1-2.3, equations for RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token, Figure 1

object_craft.structure: Build separately selectable query, passage, score, probability, token, and source panels around one canonical record graph. Preserve stable IDs through filtering and projected layouts.
object_craft.material: Use distinct shapes and text labels for query, passage, generated token, and missing provenance. Color may reinforce rank or selection but must not be the only carrier.

physical_contract.scope: Data-linked geometry for supplied or computed retrieval and generation state; no physical dynamics.
checks: Recompute stored inner products and top-k normalization against displayed values.
Verify projection and camera changes leave semantic scores, ranks, and identities unchanged.
